title: Multiple religions talk about the astral plane—some even refer to it simply as Heaven. If it is confirmed there’s a type of dream you can experience this realm, then Heaven would come to Earth by an internal process, just as Jesus prophesied. And that’s only the beginning of what would unfold...

classification.theory_summary: Proposes that “Mallworld” dreams are visits to an astral/celestial metropolis identified with religious concepts of Heaven/New Jerusalem/Devapura; suggests selective access, possible lucidity, and that the place can be intense/terrifying and contains hostile beings (Asuras/fallen angels) amid a spiritual war.
classification.skip_reason: No concrete first-person dream scene(s) with describable locations, connections, sequences, or boundaries; content is primarily theological/speculative framing with only general statements about experiences.

meta.author_theory: Mallworld is a type of dream/lucid dream that accesses an astral 'celestial city/Heaven' (New Jerusalem/Devapura); not everyone experiences it; the city can be intense/terrifying; contains hostile beings (Asuras/fallen angels) and a war; some people are shielded until emotionally ready; 'indigo children/lightworkers/starseeds' may be involved.

position.relative_to: within the Astral realm / Heaven (as described by religions)

qualities.raw_description: Described as a 'divine celestial city' / 'celestial metropolis' / 'Holy City'; 'place of divine beauty'; 'isn’t a perfect paradise—at least not yet'; can be 'overwhelming, intense, and even terrifying'; later envisioned as becoming 'a place of peace and perfection'.
Referred to as 'Astral realm' and as 'the Heaven of Svarga'.

connections.qualities: Celestial City is described as existing 'within' the Astral realm.

interactions.description: Author reports having had both 'heartwarming and amazing experiences' there and also finding the first encounter potentially less fortunate compared to those who don’t experience it; the place can be 'overwhelming, intense, and even terrifying'.
City is described (via religious framing) as containing hostile forces and a 'war' that must be won for it to become a true paradise.

entities_involved.description: Asuras (described as 'beings akin to fallen angels'); 'Satan’s army' infiltrating the Holy City; 'forces of evil'; opposed by 'Michael’s army'.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post contains generalized claims about a 'Celestial City' experienced in dreams and its affective tone (overwhelming/intense/terrifying; heartwarming/amazing) but does not provide concrete, scene-level dream geography (rooms, corridors, order of visits, boundaries) typical of extractable Mall World dream reports.
